comment: Preserved first setup miss for an independent Wizard-of-Yendor AD_SAMU route. C('g') wizgenesis created the hostile Wizard adjacent to the hero, but the plain '.' wait was stopped before a monster turn: do.c:donull() called cmd_safety_prevention(), which saw the nearby monster and returned ECMD_OK. No attack or mhitm_ad_samu gate was reached. The exact original recipe bytes and C output are archived under .cache/B105-setup-miss-safe-wait.*.
